If you no longer want these emails, the better move is to use the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the message (after confirming it points to the sender's actual domain) or set up a filter to auto-archive messages from this sender.

If you'd like a template for a manual opt-out request, here is a short one:

> Subject: Unsubscribe request
>
> Hello, please remove this address from The Automation Weekly mailing list. Thank you.
